Leaky Chimney

A leaky chimney means water is getting in — through a cracked crown, bad flashing, or a rusted cap. It soaks the brick and mortar, and causes stains, rust, and deterioration inside and out.

What can be fixed

Flashing

Lifted or rusted flashing gets resealed or replaced.

Crown

Cracked crown gets repaired or rebuilt.

Mortar Joints

Cracked mortar gets cut out and repointed.

Cap & Cover

Rusted cap or chase cover gets replaced.

Brick

Spalling brick gets replaced before it spreads.

Flue Top

Open flue gets a cap — rain and animals stay out.

Free Estimate* →

Chimney Caps

Most caps are galvanized steel. Rain, heat, and time eat the coating. Bare metal rusts, holes open, water gets in. Stainless steel is what we install.
